summary: Require all EKODI human-facing public, user, authentication and administrator surfaces to present canonical URLs without marketing or attribution tracking query parameters while preserving functional query context.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform owner explicitly instructed that ChatGPT and other external-entry tracking parameters such as ?utm_source=chatgpt.com be removed so only the intended EKODI address remains, and requested the rule be applied across all administrator and user pages as a mandatory platform rule.
runtimeEnforcement: canonical-query-policy.js performs shared edge classification and 308 canonicalization for GET/HEAD human surfaces
platform-router-entry-worker.js applies canonical query normalization before ordinary human-surface routing
shell/shell.js removes registered tracking parameters from the visible URL as a compatibility fallback
test/canonical-query-policy.test.mjs verifies tracking removal and functional-query preservation
rollback: If canonicalization causes a functional regression, revert the runtime helper/router/Shell changes to the last known-good release while retaining the approved policy intent, restore the affected functional query to the preservation set, rerun canonical-query and authentication-return regression tests, then re-promote through the guarded release pipeline.
verification: Run constitution validation, canonical-query unit tests, shared Shell tests, routing/security checks, guarded deployment, and real production URL verification using representative public, user, authentication and administrator routes.
